Subject: Customer Voice Session: Redwood + Luminex

Hi Tara —

Quick ask: would Luminex be willing to participate in a short 'Customer Voice' session at our virtual Inference Summit on Dec 16? We plan a 20–25 minute customer case highlight followed by ~10 minutes of live Q&A.

High-level:
- Format: virtual (Zoom), recorded
- Time commitment: 45–60 minute prep + 30 minutes on the day
- Deliverables from your side: a single speaker (PM/tech lead), 50–100 word bio, headshot, and a short slide (3–4 slides)

We'd also offer a co-authored one-pager and promotion across our channels. Attaching an event one-pager with audience demographics and past session highlights.

Would Arjun or someone on your team be interested? If so I’ll send a short speaker kit and proposed run of show.

Thanks and no pressure — appreciate you considering.

—
Ben Carter

ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Thanks all — Dec 10 at 10:00 AM PT works for Arjun. He prefers to keep the session focused and practical:

- 3 slides max (context → architecture changes → measurable outcomes)
- A brief callout on latency improvements and cost per inference after batching/quantization
- We are OK with the recording and co-authored extract — legal will do a final pass on the slide set after your review on Dec 9.

Two small asks from our side:
1) Can Redwood provide a short speaker honorarium or platform credits for Luminex? We typically request promotional consideration when participating in vendor events.
2) Please confirm you will not publish feature screenshots that include patient-identifiable data; we will scrub any such content before the slide review.

Attaching Arjun's preferred bio and high-res headshot for the event page.
